from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister
import numpy as np
import math

# Create a Quantum Circuit acting on a quantum register of three qubits and a classical register of one bit
qr = QuantumRegister(3, 'q')
cr = ClassicalRegister(1, 'c')
qc = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)

# Encode qubit 0 onto qubits 1 and 2 with two CNOTs
qc.cx(qr[0], qr[1])
qc.cx(qr[0], qr[2])

# Apply Hadamards to all three qubits
qc.h(qr[0])
qc.h(qr[1])
qc.h(qr[2])

# Insert a Z error on qubit 0
qc.z(qr[0])

# Apply Hadamards again
qc.h(qr[0])
qc.h(qr[1])
qc.h(qr[2])

# Decode with the same two CNOTs
qc.cx(qr[0], qr[1])
qc.cx(qr[0], qr[2])

# Correct with a Toffoli using qubits 2 and 1 as controls on qubit 0
qc.ccx(qr[2], qr[1], qr[0])

# Measure qubit 0 into classical bit 0
qc.measure(qr[0], cr[0])

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit import Parameter, ParameterVector

# Define the input and weight parameters
input_params = ParameterVector('input', 8)
weights = ParameterVector('weight', 8)

# Create the quantum circuit
qc = QuantumCircuit(4)

# Apply feature-encoding rotations
qc.ry(input_params[0], 0)
qc.rz(input_params[1], 0)
qc.ry(input_params[2], 1)
qc.rz(input_params[3], 1)
qc.ry(input_params[4], 2)
qc.rz(input_params[5], 2)
qc.ry(input_params[6], 3)
qc.rz(input_params[7], 3)

# Add CX gates
qc.cx(0, 2)
qc.cx(1, 3)

# Add a barrier
qc.barrier()

# Apply ansatz rotations
qc.ry(weights[0], 0)
qc.rz(weights[1], 1)
qc.ry(weights[2], 2)
qc.rz(weights[3], 3)
qc.rz(weights[4], 0)
qc.ry(weights[5], 1)
qc.rz(weights[6], 2)
qc.ry(weights[7], 3)

# Name the circuit
qc.name = "VQC Circuit"

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister
import numpy as np

# Create a QuantumRegister for the qubits
qr = QuantumRegister(5, name="q")
# Create a ClassicalRegister for the classical bits
cr = ClassicalRegister(4, name="c")
# Create a QuantumCircuit with the registers
circuit = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)

# Define the workspace qubits
workspace = [qr[0], qr[1]]
# Define the ancilla qubit
ancilla = qr[4]

# Apply the X gate to the first workspace qubit
circuit.x(workspace[0])

# Apply the CX gate to the workspace qubits
circuit.cx(workspace[0], workspace[1])

# Apply the CCX gate to the workspace qubits and the ancilla
circuit.ccx(workspace[0], workspace[1], ancilla)

# Apply the Z phase to the ancilla qubit
circuit.z(ancilla)

# Uncompute the workspace qubits
circuit.ccx(workspace[0], workspace[1], ancilla)
circuit.cx(workspace[0], workspace[1])
circuit.x(workspace[0])

# Draw the circuit
print(circuit.draw())

# Create a Quantum Circuit with 3 qubits and 2 classical bits

# Initialize the two input qubits to |1⟩

# Place a barrier to separate the logic

# Measure the sum and carry into two classical bits

qc.measure(qr[2], cr[1])  # Measure carry

# Draw the circuit

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister
import numpy as np
import math

def bernstein_vazirani_setup(n):
    qr = QuantumRegister(n + 1, 'q')
    cr = ClassicalRegister(n, 'c')
    circuit = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)

    # Initialize all qubits to |0>
    circuit.reset(qr)

    # Apply Hadamard to all qubits except the last one (ancilla)
    for i in range(n):
        circuit.h(qr[i])

    # Apply Hadamard followed by Z on the last qubit (ancilla)
    circuit.h(qr[n])
    circuit.z(qr[n])

    return circuit

# Example usage:
n = 3
circuit = bernstein_vazirani_setup(n)
print(circuit.draw())
```

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

def deutsch_algorithm():
    # Create a Quantum Circuit acting on a register of two qubits
    qc = QuantumCircuit(2, 1)

    # Setup stage
    qc.h(0)
    qc.h(1)
    qc.barrier()

    # Oracle stage
    qc.x(0)
    qc.cx(0, 1)
    qc.x(0)
    qc.barrier()

    # Measurement stage
    qc.h(0)
    qc.measure(0, 0)

    return qc

deutsch_circuit = deutsch_algorithm()
```

delta = Parameter('δ')

qc.rxx(math.pi, qr[1], qr[2])

qc.rz(theta, qr[0])
qc.ry(phi, qr[1])
qc.rx(lambda_, qr[2])
qc.rz(gamma, qr[0])
qc.ry(alpha, qr[1])
qc.rx(beta, qr[2])
qc.rz(delta, qr[0])

# Apply another Fredkin gate
qc.cswap(qr[1], qr[2], qr[0])

# Apply a Toffoli gate
qc.ccx(qr[1], qr[2], qr[0])

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister
import numpy as np

def qft_rotations(circuit, n, q):
    if n == 0:
        return circuit
    n -= 1
    circuit.h(q[n])
    for qubit in range(n):
        circuit.cp(np.pi/2**(qubit+1), q[qubit], q[n])
    qft_rotations(circuit, n, q)

def swap_rotations(circuit, n, q):
    for qubit in range(n//2):
        circuit.swap(q[qubit], q[n-qubit-1])
    qft_rotations(circuit, n, q)

def qft(circuit, n, q):
    qft_rotations(circuit, n, q)
    swap_rotations(circuit, n, q)

def inverse_qft(circuit, n, q):
    swap_rotations(circuit, n, q)
    qft_rotations(circuit, n, q)

q = QuantumRegister(3, 'q')
c = ClassicalRegister(3, 'c')
qc = QuantumCircuit(q, c)

# Prepare |101>
qc.x(q[0])
qc.x(q[2])

# Apply QFT
qft(qc, 3, q)

# Insert barrier
qc.barrier()

# Apply inverse QFT
inverse_qft(qc, 3, q)

# Measure all qubits
qc.measure(q, c)

qc.draw()
